messages:
Priya (Acme): Hey — noticed the 30-day trial credits we accepted yesterday are showing up on an old org called `acme-sandbox` that we thought was deleted months ago. We created a new org during SSO onboarding called `acme-main`. Billing UI shows credits on org id `org_42_old` (sandbox) instead of `org_9001` (main). Workspace id: `ws_789`. Can someone check?

Lina (Support): Sorry for the trouble — can you paste both org IDs and the email used for SSO? Quick follow-up: did anyone restore the sandbox org manually?

Priya (Acme): I didn't restore it. Our Okta re-provisioned a sandbox record when a contractor re-joined last week. Email: priya@acme.com. Confirmed org ids: `org_42_old` (sandbox) and `org_9001` (main).

billing-bot: Automated: promo `CREDIT_TRIAL_30` applied to `org_42_old` by promo-system at 2026-11-02T08:12:03Z

Samir (Customer Success): @Lina @Priya this matches a known edge case: when an archived org is re-provisioned with the same SSO external_id, our promo allocation flow can resolve to the archived row. Short repro I used locally: 1) create org with `external_id=okta:acme-123` -> archive 2) re-provision via SSO -> upsert finds the old row 3) promo allocation looks up by external_id and picks the first matching org.id. Working on a fix.

Samir (Customer Success): Short-term workaround: we can transfer the trial credit from `org_42_old` -> `org_9001` via admin API. We'll need owner consent (PII/audit). If you confirm, I'll queue a one-off transfer and attach an audit note.

Lina (Support): Priya — can you confirm Redwood is authorized to move the trial credits from `org_42_old` to `org_9001`? We'll record the authorization in your account for audit.

Priya (Acme): Confirmed. Please proceed. Also can you add a note for our finance team so they see why credits moved?

Samir (Customer Success): Executing transfer now. Internal command used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/credits/transfer \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_ADMIN" \\
  -d '{"from_org":"org_42_old","to_org":"org_9001","amount":30,"reason":"customer-approved transfer - SSO re-provision"}'
```
Transfer complete. Billing note id `bn_20261102_555`. Priya — can you confirm the credits show on `acme-main`?

Priya (Acme): Confirmed — the 30 trial credits are now on `acme-main`. Thank you! :tada:

Lina (Support): Filing an internal incident: INC-2026-1433. Samir, please include repro steps and suggested guard (e.g., require archived flag check or prefer matching on (external_id + archived=false) before allocating promos). We'll also add a short customer-facing blurb for impacted orgs.

Samir (Customer Success): Will do. ETA for a hotfix + migration: this week. I'll update INC-2026-1433 with timeline and a rollback plan. Thanks for the quick sign-off, @Priya.
